scan-pattern.webp.title: Nominal scan coverage at 100 ms and one second
scan-pattern.webp.description: Generated nominal directions, all emissions from index zero; no scene, hardware capture, noise or material response.

motion-accuracy.svg.title: Measured motion replay: held and rolling acquisition
motion-accuracy.svg.description: Original baseline: 400,000 emissions over a two-second high-motion MoCap segment in an exact static room; 1 ms pose boundaries. MuJoCo rolling origin bound 0.5 mm. Range agreement with an interpolated measured-pose reference, not hardware precision.

runtime.svg.title: Original static-room runtime comparison
runtime.svg.description: Original matched static-room baseline, 400,000 emissions / two simulated seconds, Ryzen 9 9950X3D + RTX 5090. Warp uses opt-in caller-owned history, headless stepping and USD writeback off. Native physics runs in both loops. Different scan directions and runtime boundaries; not identical-ray microbenchmarks or full-robot capacity.

ros-callbacks.svg.title: ROS Python callback intervals for two message formats
ros-callbacks.svg.description: One 30-second full-rate single-stream Cyclone reference per format, Apple M5 Max / macOS arm64 / rclpy. Interval is publisher-call start to Python callback, including representation, deserialization and scheduling; not isolated DDS wire time. Includes five warmup packets in delivery counts.
